source: real data census: 8,527 messages, 25,194 tags (TEXT*.DAT, project source)

tags.name: Page break: wait for a button, then a new page
tags.game: Codec control 0x0B (codec.py: from the game's decoder, SLUS 0x8005A884); round trip is byte-exact.
tags.picoripi: Parsed by codec.py; rendered as its tag text in the editor; written back byte-exact (round trip).
tags.translator: Keep; it may move inside the message, never delete (it sets the page count).

tags.name: Left speaker: portrait number (00 removes it)
tags.game: Left portrait slot, SLUS_006.28: the text code calls 0x8005B2F0 with a1=0x10 and stores its result at gp+0x634 (stores at 0x8005B27C and 0x8005A780; reads at 0x8005B270, 0x8005A768). The slot keeps its value across pages. Number selects the FACE_nnn portrait (FACE header ids); names come from a fan script (speaker_names.json), not checked on screen. Preview and name alias use it.
tags.picoripi: Parsed by codec.py; rendered as its tag text in the editor; written back byte-exact (round trip).
tags.translator: Keep the code; a translator may move it inside a message but must not change the number (it picks the speaker).

tags.name: Right speaker: portrait number (00 removes it)
tags.game: Right portrait slot, SLUS_006.28: the same routine with a1=0x20 and a3=0x8000, stored at gp+0x636 (store at 0x8005B298, read at 0x8005B28C). The screen X of the right portrait is not traced yet (preview uses 249, an estimate). Name alias uses it.
tags.picoripi: Parsed by codec.py; rendered as its tag text in the editor; written back byte-exact (round trip).
tags.translator: Keep the code, same rule as FA.

tags.name: Line break inside a window (raw glyph byte 0x02)
tags.status: owner's observation on screen; routine not traced
tags.game: The game draws the text after {raw:02} on the next line of the same window (owner's screenshots 115/116). The print routine's check of byte 0x02 is not traced in SLUS_006.28.
tags.picoripi: Preview, width counter and the 3-line rule treat it as a line end; the stored bytes stay {raw:02}. Auto-wrap keeps the tag.
tags.translator: Keep it where the game breaks the line. Do not replace it with a newline.

tags.name: One-byte glyph of the game's table (raw mode)
tags.game: codec.py: outside a compressed run any byte below 0xD6 is one table glyph; kept as {raw:HH}. Each byte's picture is unknown.
tags.picoripi: Parsed by codec.py; rendered as its tag text in the editor; written back byte-exact (round trip).
tags.translator: Keep as it is; the editor shows the byte; never edit by hand.

tags.name: End of message without a wait (byte 0xFF)
tags.game: Terminator 0xFF after a raw message (codec.py); the editor shows it at the end only.
tags.picoripi: Parsed by codec.py; rendered as its tag text in the editor; written back byte-exact (round trip).
tags.translator: Keep at the end; not written by the translator.
